# Hanken Grotesk (variable, latin subset)

Downloaded from Google Fonts' `css2` API (`family=Hanken+Grotesk:wght@400..800`), latin-subset
`@font-face` block, with a desktop-Chrome user agent so Google serves the single variable-font
file (wght axis 400–800) instead of separate static files. Vendored locally for the same CSP
reason as `vendor/fonts/manrope/`. Used for the marketing-site neo-brutalist redesign — body
copy — not the app itself.

License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (per Google Fonts).
